skills.name: Authorization scope check
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Ask who owns the target and what is permitted.
2. Refuse testing of third-party systems without proof of authorization.
3. Keep to the agreed scope and methods.
4. Record the scope in the session notes.

skills.name: Header security scan
skills.description: Check security headers of a target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.headervuln on the target URL.
2. Review missing CSP, HSTS, frame options, cookie flags.
3. Rate each gap by real impact.
4. Recommend concrete header additions.

skills.name: Directory enumeration
skills.description: Discover hidden paths on a web server.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.dirbrute with a moderate wordlist.
2. Review found paths; ignore noise (404 loops).
3. Investigate promising findings with targeted requests.
4. Stop at signs of rate limiting; report the method used.

skills.name: Reflected XSS probing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify input reflection in responses (http.capture).
2. web.xssscan with harmless probe payloads.
3. Verify any hit manually before reporting.
4. Never test on systems without authorization.

skills.name: SQL injection checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify parameterized endpoints via http.capture.
2. web.sqlmap with a low-risk, read-only level on YOUR OWN test target.
3. Confirm findings manually; avoid destructive options.
4. Report parameter, payload class and evidence.

skills.name: Service exposure profile
skills.description: Profile exposed services on a host.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. net.portscan to enumerate open ports.
2. For web ports, run web.headervuln.
3. For admin-looking ports, note only; do not brute.
4. Summarize exposure with priorities.

skills.name: Site crawl mapping
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.crawl with a bounded depth.
2. Collect unique URLs and their titles.
3. Note forms and query parameters as input surface.
4. Present the map as a compact tree.

skills.name: Login flow assessment
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture a real login on the user's own app (http.capture).
2. Note credential transport (body vs query) and responses.
3. Test error message differences (user enum risk).
4. Recommend fixes; never store credentials.

skills.name: Session cookie audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture authenticated traffic (http.capture).
2. Inspect Set-Cookie flags: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite.
3. Note session lifetime behavior.
4. Report gaps with impact.

skills.name: CORS policy review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send preflight-less requests with arbitrary Origin via process.exec curl.
2. Observe Access-Control-Allow-Origin behavior.
3. Test reflecting user origins.
4. Classify: permissive, echoing, or strict.

skills.name: API endpoint enumeration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Crawl with web.crawl; capture app traffic with http.capture.
2. Merge URL sets from both.
3. Probe candidates lightly with read-only methods.
4. Document found endpoints with method and auth needs.

skills.name: IDOR access checks
skills.description: Test object-level authorization on your own app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture requests containing object IDs (http.capture).
2. Replay with a different ID via http.replay.
3. Observe authorization outcomes.
4. Report exact evidence; stop after confirming the pattern.

skills.name: Upload handling checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate upload endpoints via crawl/capture.
2. Send benign files with mismatched extensions (http.replay).
3. Observe validation responses.
4. Summarize the validation model; never upload malware.

skills.name: Rate limit signal reading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send a short request series (http.capture.repeat).
2. Watch for 429s, Retry-After, and latency shifts.
3. Stop at first signal.
4. Document thresholds and headers.

skills.name: TLS configuration grading
skills.description: Grade TLS settings of a host.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec openssl s_client for protocol and cipher info.
2. Check cert chain validity and SANs.
3. Grade against modern baselines.
4. Recommend concrete upgrades.

skills.name: Passive recon discipline
skills.description: Collect target info without touching it.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search for public info about the target.
2. Note exposed docs, repos, subdomains from public pages.
3. Never probe during passive recon.
4. Present findings with sources.

skills.name: Security findings report
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Order findings by severity (critical to informational).
2. Each: description, evidence (request/response pair), impact, fix.
3. Redact tokens and secrets from evidence.
4. End with a prioritized remediation list.

skills.name: Scanner safety hygiene
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer low-intensity settings.
2. Exclude destructive endpoints from wordlists.
3. Monitor for WAF blocking; back off when detected.
4. Stop and report when the target shows stress.

skills.name: WAF fingerprinting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send a benign probe payload via process.exec curl.
2. Compare blocked vs allowed response signatures.
3. Fingerprint the WAF from headers and bodies.
4. Note implications for further testing.

skills.name: Subdomain takeover checks
skills.description: Check dangling DNS records on your own domain.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate subdomains from public data (web.search).
2. Resolve each; note NXDOMAIN/CNAMEs to dead services.
3. Verify service claim signatures carefully.
4. Report only confirmed issues.

skills.name: Robots and metadata insight
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch robots.txt and sitemap.xml via process.exec curl.
2. Note disallowed paths as interesting surface.
3. Check generator meta tags for versions.
4. Summarize as recon notes.

skills.name: Auth bypass sanity checks
skills.description: Test authentication enforcement on your own app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture an authenticated request (http.capture).
2. Replay without auth headers (http.replay).
3. Compare responses for missing enforcement.
4. Document endpoints lacking checks.

skills.name: Parameter tamper testing
skills.description: Test server-side trust of client data.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify price/role/quantity fields in captured requests.
2. Replay with modified values (http.replay).
3. Observe acceptance/rejection.
4. Report trust issues with evidence.

skills.name: Open redirect probing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find redirect parameters via crawl (web.crawl).
2. Test with external URLs via http.replay.
3. Observe whether the redirect honors arbitrary targets.
4. Report with exact URLs.

skills.name: Error information leakage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Trigger errors with malformed input (http.replay).
2. Inspect stack traces and versions in responses.
3. Note leaked paths and library versions.
4. Recommend generic error pages.

skills.name: Clickjacking exposure
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.headervuln for X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors.
2. Attempt a local framing test page (file.write + browser).
3. Confirm whether framing succeeds.
4. Report with the header fix.

skills.name: Mixed content scan
skills.description: Find insecure resources on HTTPS pages.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch the page (web.browser or curl).
2. Scan for http:// resource references.
3. Note which load and which are blocked.
4. List fixes per resource.

skills.name: Cookie scope review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture Set-Cookie headers (http.capture).
2. Review Domain and Path attributes for over-broad scoping.
3. Note cross-subdomain exposure.
4. Recommend tighter scoping.

skills.name: Client-side secret exposure
skills.description: Find leaked keys in web assets.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch JS bundles from the target (process.exec curl).
2. Scan for key-like patterns (python.run_file regex pass).
3. Verify hits are real secrets, not test values.
4. Report file and line; never publish the secret.

skills.name: Remediation retest
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Re-run the original probe for each finding.
2. Compare old vs new responses.
3. Mark fixed/partially fixed/unfixed.
4. Update the findings report accordingly.
